analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Limited held its earnings conference call for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The company reported total volume sales of 15,000 metric tons for FY26, with export revenues rising to approximately 63% of total revenues. Management discussed progress on Unit 3, noting delays in Phase 1 due to regulatory approvals and monsoons, while targeting Phase 2 commissioning by March 2027. Management highlighted strong current demand supported by an order book of 4,000 metric tons and anticipated margin expansion from a higher share of premium excipient products. Accent Microcell Limited reported financial results for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting strong revenue and profit growth alongside capacity expansion initiatives.

guidance.claim: Management expects blended profit margins to increase by at least 2 to 3 percentage points as the company shifts toward more premium products.
guidance.quote: It will be prudent enough to assume going ahead, as we are going ahead with more premium range of products, so it is prudent enough to assume that the blended profit margins are going to increase by, say, at least 2-3 percentage.

guidance.claim: Management projects premium product revenue share from Unit 3 Phase 1 to settle at around 16 to 17 percent for FY27.
guidance.quote: Gradually, it is going to increase, but for H2 or for entire finance year 27, it's going to be, say, more or less 16 to 17%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a 15% to 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.

guidance.claim: The company expects Phase 1 capacity utilization to be around 60% for the first year.
guidance.quote: from current fiscal given a full year capacity, we are expecting it to be utility level, to be around 60% for the 1st year.

demand_outlook.claim: The current demand outlook for MCC remains favorable supported by existing orders on hand.
demand_outlook.quote: So, currency, current, MCC demand outlook is good, taking into account our existing order book.

demand_outlook.claim: Export sales increased to approximately 63% of revenue in FY26 compared to 53% in the prior year.
demand_outlook.quote: ODAC exports, it's roughly, say, around 63%, which was, 53% last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Accent Microcell achieved total volume sales of 15,000 metric tons in FY26.
In H2 FY26, approximately 90% of MCC Spheres produced were exported.
demand_outlook.quote: So, basically, going ahead, our export revenue is going to increase because MCC Spheres, in the H2, we have almost exported. 90% of the MCC Spheres was exported.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has seen an increase in product inquiries globally.
demand_outlook.quote: of course is, there has been product. Inquiry has been increased, and we have been taking care of the business from our business side.

demand_outlook.claim: The global MCC market CAGR is expected to increase by 1% to 1.5% over the next couple of years from its base of 5% to 6%.
demand_outlook.quote: currently. if we talk about CAGR, so about 5 to 6% and upcoming times, at least for a couple of years, that would be. We are expecting to increase at least one to 1.5% more, because, beside pharma nutraceutical segments, there are so many other segments are also, you can say, overall, good business is materializing.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market size of MCC is identified to be around 250,000 metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: in terms of quantity we are identified that the total of MCC. As such, is around 2,50,000 metric ton.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian domestic market size for MCC is around 50,000 metric tons per annum.
demand_outlook.quote: We have 2.5 lakh is globally 50,000 metric ton for the Indian market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company targets a mix of 70% exports and 30% domestic supply for its new products.
demand_outlook.quote: So 70%, it will be export in the global market, and 30 will be domestic supply.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 will manufacture premium excipients, whereas Phase 2 will focus on MCC.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 will cater to, say, a premium range of excipient products, and Phase 2 will cater to MCC.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 commercialization was delayed primarily due to two abnormal monsoons and regulatory licensing requirements for greenfield projects.
capex_expansion.quote: The delay in Phase 1 was, primarily due to two reasons, two back-to-back abnormal monsoons, and, certain licensing work, read with, say, regulatory approvals that was required, being, project treated as, greenfield.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of Unit 3 is expected to go live in March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Sir, Phase 2, say, it will be premature for me to give any kind of an exact deadline, but as of now, we are expecting it to go live in the month of, March 27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has acquired land capable of accommodating up to Phase 6 expansions.
capex_expansion.quote: Good question Mr. Priyank, we have purchased land for till phase 6.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 has a planned annual production capacity of 2,400 metric tons.
capex_expansion.quote: Madam, we need to… read with, weighted average capacity, the capacity of, Unit 3, phase 1 is 2,400 metric ton per nm.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capex for Unit 3, excluding land, is expected to be between 105 to 110 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: total capex for entire unit 3 as of now, that is phase 1 phase 2, except the land portion, I think. It will be around say, it will be anywhere between 105 to 110 cr.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex for Phase 2 of Unit 3 is estimated to be around 55 to 60 crores, excluding land.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2. Correct. Yes, sir, it is around 55 to 60 crore, except the value of land.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects Phase 2 of Unit 3 to commence trial runs in July 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: we're expecting it to be in the month of say, July 2,026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company purchased land from promoters to build a new warehouse for inventory storage.
capex_expansion.quote: land was purchased from the parties that you stated for which due to the lack of the say inventory, for which inventory storage was required. Say, we have, build up a new go down as well. Warehouse as well on the land that is purchased by the companies.

margins_costs.claim: Nominal price increases in imported wood pulp raw material have been fully passed on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, whatever the, say, nominal increase in the cost, for the import of raw material that is wood pulp has been completely passed on through the customer.

margins_costs.claim: Accent Microcell maintains an overall gross profit margin of approximately 38%.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, I think, say, we are going to say, at the most, I can share the GP percentage with you. So, gross profit percentage is around 38%, so I guess, more or less, your concern, or rather, the question will be answered through that percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Trading activities generate lower profit margins of approximately 4 to 5 percent.
margins_costs.quote: And about the trading margins, I think we have said it earlier as well. Trading margins are 4-5%, as compared to the, blended profit margins that what you are seeing in the phase of the profit and loss account.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for FY26 was reported at 12.57%.
The company's EBITDA margin was around 16% prior to the Unit 3 expansion.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin was around 16% going ahead as we are coming out with unique 3 in phase, manner, that is phase one and phase 2.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects a 5% to 7% increase in finished goods sales due to its new range of premium products.
margins_costs.quote: roughly, you can say around say, 5 to 7 percentage say, increase in the sales of finished goods because of the new range that we have started selling off, namely, SMCC, Spheres powder cellulose, and other say, combination co-process. MCC.

margins_costs.claim: The price of CCS is approximately 3.5 times the price of MCC.
margins_costs.quote: The price of CC. CCS is around 3.5 times of MCC.

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds an executable order book of approximately 4,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Taking into account, say, domestic and export market, we have roughly around, 4,000 metric tons orders on hand with us.

orders_capacity.claim: The combined installed capacity of the two existing plants is approximately 10,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Yeah, and the installed capacity for both the plant is roughly around 10,000 metric ton.

orders_capacity.claim: In FY26, manufactured volumes accounted for 70% of total capacity utilization while trading accounted for 25 to 30%.
orders_capacity.quote: And, about, say, volume growth that you are referring to, say, around, say, 70% of the, say, total, export, or rather, the capacity utilization was from the manufacturing capacity, and roughly 25-30% was from the traded volumes.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed production capacity of 100 metric tons per month for MCC Spheres.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, say, we have, say, around, 100 metric ton capacity for MCC Spears, and we have… to the extent that we can recall, we have not said that we are the only players in MCC Spears.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity at Pirana (Ahmedabad) Unit I is 2,000 MTPA with 100% capacity utilisation.
Installed capacity at Dahej (SEZ) Unit II is 7,200 MTPA with 95% capacity utilisation.
The company's current capacity is 9,600 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: 9,600 is our current capacity, so our phase? One, is about 2,400.

orders_capacity.claim: Phase 1 capacity will be 2,400 metric tons per annum, and Phase 2 will add 12,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: phase one at 100% capacity utilization. It will be around 2,400 metric ton per annum and phase 2 will be 12,000 metric ton

orders_capacity.claim: Unit 1 has an installed capacity of 2,400 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: unit one will having a capacity of 2,400 metric ton per annum, as of now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has 7,200 metric tons of capacity from its Dahej unit.
The Pirana plant operated at 100% capacity utilization throughout the year for the last three years.
orders_capacity.quote: the capacity utilization from pirana plant was 100% throughout the year. For all the 3 years.

capital_allocation.claim: Unit 3 Phase 2 capex will be funded through rights issue proceeds and internal accruals without requiring new debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Because Phase 2, Phase 2, we are going to fund it out from right issue, and to a certain extent, internal equals. And for working capital, we… as of now, we don't foresee any kind of further borrowing requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: Trade receivables stood at approximately 90 crores for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Trade receivables this year also are almost around 90 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Accent Microcell maintains existing working capital and term loan borrowing limits with Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: Sir, we have, existing, say, working capital and, term loan limits, with, Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited. So, going ahead, in case required, we are going to utilize the same for, say, company as a whole.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised around 40 crores through a rights issue.
capital_allocation.quote: for the fund raising that what you have done for the right issue. It is around 40 crores, and the total cost of phase 2 will be around roughly between 55 to 60 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company may consider a nominal amount of debt if required for working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: if required nominal amount of debt can be thought of.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is making efforts to reduce its current working capital cycle.
capital_allocation.quote: Every business sets optimistic target to reduce the working capital days we are making all the efforts to ensure that the working cycle which stand at present is reduced.

risks_headwinds.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 was delayed due to greenfield project licensing requirements and two consecutive abnormal monsoons.
risks_headwinds.quote: The delay in Phase 1 was, primarily due to two reasons, two back-to-back abnormal monsoons, and, certain licensing work, read with, say, regulatory approvals that was required, being, project treated as, greenfield.

risks_headwinds.claim: Current year financial results absorbed an exceptional cost impact associated with new labor laws.
risks_headwinds.quote: And in addition to OBO, there was an, say, kind of an exceptional item in the current year as well, wherein the, huge impact of the labor code was also taken by us.

risks_headwinds.claim: On-site execution activities were impacted by two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: Two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacting on-site execution activities

risks_headwinds.claim: Extended liaisoning timelines were required for obtaining the required regulatory approvals.
risks_headwinds.quote: Extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining the required regulatory approvals

risks_headwinds.claim: There is currently no clarity regarding tariffs for the pharmaceutical sector.
risks_headwinds.quote: as of now, to the extent would you understand? There is no clarity regarding tariff for the Pharma sector.

risks_headwinds.claim: Debtor days have increased because the company offered liberal payment terms to target Indian MNCs.
risks_headwinds.quote: that data needs to be read with, the say, certain percentage decrease in the export sales as well, because we have started targeting Indian MNCs wherein to enter or to have a competitive edge. Labor payment terms have been offered by the company.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 2 to go live in March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, Phase 2, say, it will be premature for me to give any kind of an exact deadline, but as of now, we are expecting it to go live in the month of, March 27.

management_commitments.claim: Management tentatively plans to start Phase 3 expansion in 2028 after Phase 2 is successfully executed.
management_commitments.quote: Almost in 2028 will start the Phase 3.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects working capital and trade receivable stretch to normalize by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, if not by, H1 of financial year 27, surely by, say, end of financial 27, it will be taken care of.

management_commitments.quote: we're expecting it to be in the month of say, July 2,026.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve a 15% to 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.
